description: The pinned Emscripten SDK (RFC 0029 decision 1). tools/render/webgpu_lane.py emsdk owns fetching the emsdk archive at its pinned commit, verifying its sha256, extracting it into dependencies/<directory> and installing and activating exactly this SDK version (emsdk's own release manifest names the compiler build, release_hash below); the lane then requires emcc to report emcc_identity. The browser's webgpu.h is the emdawnwebgpu package of the pinned Dawn release (quality/toolchain/webgpu.json), used as a local Emscripten port.
emcc_identity: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.10 (d6c521a7f05449857c76bd99e396895583cf2083)
